meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会对比当前代码与最新发布的 npm 版本,逐个读取提交的 diff,按三个发布层(omo pure components、omo opencode、omo codex)整理未发布的变更,并给出每层及总体的版本升级建议。
howto.when: 当你说到“unpublished changes”“changelog”“what changed”“whats new”等触发词,或要求查看未发布变更时触发。

say.text: 看看我有哪些未发布的变更
按发布层整理未发布改动,并给出版本升级建议
say.note: Claude 会按三层分类并推荐 semver 升级。

say.text: 对比最新发布的 npm 版本,列出 changelog
say.note: Claude 会读取 diff 生成变更日志。

howto.what_en: Compares HEAD with the latest published npm versions, reads each commit's actual diff, classifies changes into three release layers (omo pure components, omo opencode, omo codex), and recommends a version bump per layer plus an overall bump.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "unpublished changes", "changelog", "what changed", "whats new", or ask about unpublished changes.

say_en.note: Compares HEAD with the latest npm release and lists them.

say_en.text: Group unpublished changes by release layer and suggest version bumps
say_en.note: Classifies by layer and recommends semver updates.

say_en.text: Compare against the latest published npm version and list a changelog
say_en.note: Reads diffs and generates a changelog.
